text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I gave it everything I had, trying my 
absolute hardest... and somehow, I managed 
to win...!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
My feelings reached Zephyr-san. She said 
it gave her the courage to face the wall 
before her and give it her all.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
The next race is the Sprinters Stakes. 
Zephyr-san and Bakushin O-san will be 
there, just like last year. But it's going 
to be completely different!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I've changed, and you've become an even 
more wonderful Trainer. I want to give you 
a victory... one that is truly fitting for 
who we are today!
